messages:
alice. infra: Heads-up — carrier just pinged, our H100 batch (alloc A-382) is stuck in FRA customs. ETA slipped ~48h. AWB: HX123456789DE. Need decisions on replacement vs wait + RMA for 6 DOA units.
benops: ack. do we have photos / DOA manifest yet?
chloe-supply: vendor said customs paperwork missing HS code confirmation. they asked for invoice copy and return auth number. I already uploaded invoice to the portal.
omar-sre: FYI this pushes capacity for next-week jobs. We should free 8 GPUs from staging pool if delay >24h. Any cost impact on reserved nodes?
chloe-supply: @benops can you confirm if forwarder will consolidate with next flight or hold at FRA? if consolidate, transit might be +72h.
marco-hyperlane: Marco (HyperLane): We're on it. Forwarder confirms hold pending HS classification. Consolidation possible but need customer's acceptance for rebook fee (~€1,200). RMA: we can pre-issue RMA IDs for DOA so returns start ASAP.
alice. infra: ok please pre-issue RMA IDs. also, can vendor send replacement loaners from our EU pool instead of waiting? that would avoid capacity hit.
marco-hyperlane: we have 10 loaners available in AMS pool. Can push 6 as overnight air, additional 4 as ground. Extra freight charge applies. ETA for overnight: ~26h.
benops: rough numbers on freight + customs rebook: freight overnight €2,600 + customs broker fee €220. Rebook fee option if consolidated: €1,200. Which do we choose?
omar-sre: prefer loaners if cost < downstream SLA penalty. What would SLA penalty look like for missed reserved throughput? estimate: our infra cost + customer P0 credit ~€4,500 per missed day.
chloe-supply: math suggests loaner overnight (€2.6k+€220=~€2.82k) < SLA penalty (€4.5k). Recommend accept overnight loaner for the 6 units.
alice. infra: agree. proceed with overnight loaners. Marco, confirm AWB and provide RMA IDs and sample return label template we can attach to DOA units.
marco-hyperlane: sending now. RMA IDs: RMA-HL-7781, RMA-HL-7782, RMA-HL-7783, RMA-HL-7784, RMA-HL-7785, RMA-HL-7786. RMA list attached in portal. AWB for overnight: HX987654321DE. Label template snippet:
```
SHIP_TO: HyperLane Depot FRA
AWB: HX987654321DE
RETURN_ID: RMA-HL-7781
```
logistics-bot: automatic note: created ticket INFRA-1729 to track loaner shipment and DOA reconciliation. ETA field set to 26h.
benops: Chloe, please sign off on vendor invoice for overnight movement. I'll approve customs broker payment.
chloe-supply: signed. please route PO amendment + cost center 430-infra.
omar-sre: I'll trigger capacity shift: free 8 GPUs from staging pool at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. notify teams.
alice. infra: also ask Marco whether vendor will handle customs clearance for returns or we need to coordinate pick-up. want to avoid double handling.
marco-hyperlane: We will clear returns inbound to HyperLane depot, but outbound to vendor repair center requires EORI confirmation. If you want direct vendor repair, share EORI and invoice copy.
alice. infra: EORI already on file for EU account. forwarding invoice link now: https://files.redwoodinfra.company/invoices/A382.pdf
benops: small ask — tag this as recoverable on next procurement forecast so finance can reconcile loaner freight to supplier credit.
chloe-supply: flagged. I'll add note to vendor invoice requesting freight credit claim against batch A-382.
omar-sre: once loaners arrive, we should run smoke on 2 units first, then drain and swap. Make runbook note: `swap-seq: smoke->drain->uninstall->label-return`
alice. infra: thanks everyone. final check: Marco, confirm RMA pickup window for the DOA units (we need a 48h pickup after swap).
marco-hyperlane: Pickup scheduled 48-72h after our depot receives returns. I'll update INFRA-1729 with pickup ETA tomorrow morning.
alice. infra: perfect. closing loop — I'll post update to #eng-runtime and tag customers impacted. :white_check_mark:
